messages.author: 2dc50513792871a4
messages.subject: navlistPanel problem
parts:
I am using the navlistPanel function in the latest version of Shiny just installed from github, version 0.8.0.99. As per the help documentation, I am trying to condition on the "value" arguments of the tabPanels within a navlistPanel call by referring to the navlistPanel "id" argument. For example, if I set id="p1" then I can access the value elsewhere by calling input$p1.

However, the problem I am having is that input$p1 returns NULL always. It does this initially of course. I cannot tell if this is because no tabPanel is initially selected or if it just does not register at all. But it does appear that it only runs once. If I continue to click on the navigation list in the browser, my console does not repeatedly register NULL for input$p1 despite my forced print(input$p1). So it doesn't seem to update.

Interestingly, if I change the function from navlistPanel back to the original tabsetPanel, input$p1 now returns the correct "value" for the active tabPanel and full reactivity is restored. So the argument "id" seems to work for tabsetPanel the same as it always has, but not for navlistPanel, unless I am missing something.

Thanks,
Matt
